|gr1= Unit Control

|arg= local

|descr= Order the given unit(s) to follow another from his own group (via radio).
It can also be used to resume unit formation after e.g [[doStop]].

|s1= unit [[commandFollow]] unitLead

|p1= unit: [[Object]] or [[Array]] of [[Object]]s

|p2= unitLead: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>_soldier1 commandFollow _soldier2;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>(units group _leader - [_leader]) commandFollow _leader; // returns all the units (but the leader) to formation</sqf>
